frequency_question: How often does a central bank successfully complete the administrative, legal, and operational sequence for a liquidity impoundment tool within a quarter?
membership_rule: Includes any formal central bank announcement introducing or re-introducing a secondary reserve ratio or incremental reserve requirement on scheduled or unscheduled monetary policy review dates. Excludes standard benchmark rate changes.
provenance_note: claims 24 cases from only 2 named (12.0x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 2 named instances of iCRR deployments within the last decade, out of approximately 24 total standard policy review cycles.
known_gaps: Excludes minor adjustments to standard CRR that did not use the 'incremental' (iCRR) nomenclature.
skeleton: RBI monetary policy committee meeting cycles per year (6) multiplied by years in the decade (4) yielding scheduled windows, plus potential inter-meeting emergency notifications.
multiplier: 6 scheduled meetings per year * 4 years (2023-2026) = 24 windows. Total relevant historical deployments = 2.
validity_reason: Central bank administrative procedures and notification protocols remain stable over multi-year horizons unless major legislative overhauls occur.
